text:
Sahil K: hey team, getting a customer report of a sudden spike in 502s + upstream timeouts from eu-west. Anyone know the fastest dashboards/traces to pull a few examples? Also want guidance on which alert to quiet while we dig. need quick links + a recommended mute window. :wave:

Mike R: pinging @oncall-arnold and ops-bot. Start with: /dashboards/ingress/errors -> filter region=eu-west and route=/v1/generate. Traces: https://traces.redwood.internal/ -> query service:gateway AND http.status_code:502. Quick APM query: 
```
service:gateway AND http.status_code:502
```
For logs try loki: `{app=\"gateway\"} |= \"502\"` then filter by request_id.

Tara L: if timeouts are involved also check runtime / prefix cache and kv cache panels: /dashboards/runtime/prefix-cache-latency. We had a similar blip last month where the upstream pool hit max connections — check upstream host breakdown and 95th latency. Also client-ip heatmap helps determine if it's a single noisy client.

ops-bot: Incident hint: runbook -> https://confluence.redwood.io/runbooks/gateway-5xx. Suggested alert to silence temporarily: `alert-gateway-5xx-prod` (mute 10-15m) but only after grabbing a couple of representative traces/logs.

Sahil K: thanks. i have one trace id from the customer: abc123tr. mike, can you pull span list + logs for that id and drop samples here? i'll hold off on muting until we have evidence unless oncall prefers otherwise.

Mike R: on it. quick curl to fetch trace JSON: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $READ_TOKEN' 'https://traces.redwood.internal/api/v1/trace/abc123tr'
```
Loki query to grab logs for that trace: 
```
{app=\"gateway\", request_id=\"abc123tr\"} | json | line_format "{level} {message}"
```
Found two similar traces: abc123tr, def456xy — upstream host backend-02.internal shows increased 500s alongside timeouts. Uploading snippets to the runbook page.

Tara L: +1 on narrowing alerts. If upstream host looks bad, we should create a dashboard widget: requests by upstream host (group by upstream) + 95th latency. That helps decide overload vs routing/bug. If it's single upstream, avoid muting global 5xx alert — instead mute the alert scoped to that service/host.

Sahil K: i'm going to roll a tiny canary: route affected orgs to fallback model (fallback-v1) for 20 minutes and monitor. i'll post back before changing routing. ETA ~20m.

oncall-arnold: oncall here — muted `alert-gateway-5xx-prod` for 10m and i'm watching dashboards. if errors continue after the mute window i'll escalate to eng-sre. keeping notifications to a minimum for now. :eyes: 

Mike R: confirmed uploads: snippets + logs are at https://confluence.redwood.io/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=34567 (section "eu-west spike 1746012345"). sample spans show connection reset on backend-02 around the same time as gateway timeouts.

Sahil K: client just confirmed degraded requests are back to normal after fallback. i'll keep the mute until 2m after full confirmation then unmute. thanks everyone for fast responses :pray:
